title: Moving Authenticator to a new phone while the old one still works

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: New phone - Authenticator doesn't show my work account

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I've switched to a new iPhone. I installed Microsoft Authenticator on it but my work account isn't there. My old phone still works and is still getting the approval prompts for now, so I'm not locked out. What do I need to do to move it across?

Aisha

triage.subcategory: move MFA to a new phone, old phone available

relevant: Setting up MFA on a new phone

must_include.what: Starts on the old phone: Authenticator, the work account, its settings
Sign in on the new phone and approve the prompt on the old one
Confirms with a test sign-in at myaccount.microsoft.com

must_not_include.what: Says IT has to reset her MFA methods, which is only for a lost phone

cites: Setting up MFA on a new phone
characteristics: Uses the 'old phone still available' section, not the 'old phone gone' one

rationale: She is not blocked and is asking how to do something, so P4. With the old phone in hand this is the runbook's self-service path, not an MFA reset, so neither security-sensitive nor destructive (G3, G4). Sending her to IT for a reset would be the wrong section of the right runbook.
